notes.title: Patchnotes 22/12/2017
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30975245/87872cb8c4920d32179330b0a5f379dc8849518e.png

  fixed color adaptation to actually shift color gradually towards biome color
  sparkles for cub selection (to start next generation)
  tornado removed (will be reintroduced when I add and fix weather system)
  added snow biome content (trees, bushes, rocks and fruits! Yummy Cinnabuns :3 )
  fixed respawn sometimes going to next generation (hopefully)
  cub selection is now yellow (more visible on snow)
  added grass and flowers all over the place
  fixed temperature issue from hot climate, it should now go down when leaving desert
  added grasslands music
  added main menu and loading screen
  Options menu is now functional (currently has only volume as options and it doesn't save when leaving the game)
  cubs should not be able to spawn in den walls anymore

notes.title: Hotfix for major respawn issues
notes.content:
I just uploaded several hotfixes for the game, seems like some bugs were sneaking past me that really shouldn't have ;)

patchnotes hotfix:

 Cubs should respawn in a sensible amount (6-12)
 Cubs should be able to die now
 Tornado stops hugging the world borders and is now accessable and more furious
 Inheritance of colors was screwed through biome adapation process, should be fixed now
 Tornado generally moves more around map aswell


if you find anything game breaking, please write a post in the bug report forums, I appreciate the help ^^
